items.title: Spatially resolved multimodal hallmarks of response to neoadjuvant immunotherapies in the melanoma ecosystem in 2D and 3D
items.abstract_or_text: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy has transformed cancer treatment, yet the spatial molecular architecture governing response and resistance across distinct immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) regimens remains poorly defined. We assembled the largest neoadjuvant ICB (NICB) spatial multi-omics cohort to date, profiling over 112 million cells at single-cell resolution across three melanoma ICB regimens using MERFISH spatial transcriptomics, multiplexed immunofluorescence, and scRNA-sequencing. These analyses revealed the full multicellular spatial architecture of the NICB tumor microenvironment, including mature TLS with germinal centers, TCF7+ stem-like T cells, myeloid cells organized into spatially distinct cellular neighborhoods with unique intercellular signaling circuits, and CCL19/CCL21-expressing fibroblasts as a previously unrecognized stromal scaffold sustaining these immune hubs. We developed three purpose-built computational tools that together enabled comprehensive quantification of this microenvironment for the first time: SCIRA for whole-slide single-cell receptor-ligand quantification, GCSCAN for molecularly grounded TLS and germinal center structural delineation, and PathNet-TLS for automated TLS detection on H&E images. Applying these tools across the cohort, we defined the immune and stromal composition and cellular neighborhood organization distinguishing responders from non-responders. We also quantified cell-cell interactions and regimen-specific immune architectures, including a markedly stronger mature TLS/germinal center response with IPI-NIVO than NIVO-RELA. Importantly, GCSCAN-quantified TLS and germinal center density each stratified disease-free survival, with responders that lack germinal centers having an elevated risk of relapse. Open-top light-sheet imaging and CODA-based 3D reconstruction further uncovered interconnected germinal center-TLS tunnels invisible to standard 2D histopathology. These findings establish a discovery-to-tool paradigm linking single-cell tumor microenvironment interrogation to clinically deployable computational pathology for biomarker-driven NICB assessment across cancer types.
items.summary_zh: 最大规模的新辅助免疫检查点阻断空间多组学队列，以超过 1.12 亿个单细胞解析黑色素瘤治疗响应相关的三级淋巴结构、免疫—基质生态位及其三维组织。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模空间单细胞、病理图像和三维重建形成了从机制发现到计算病理工具的完整链条；但其响应与复发风险关联仍需在独立前瞻性队列中验证，不能据此推断特定细胞生态位导致疗效。
items.abstract_zh: 新辅助免疫治疗改变了癌症治疗，但支配不同免疫检查点阻断（ICB）方案响应与耐药的空间分子结构仍缺乏清晰界定。我们组建了迄今最大的、新辅助 ICB（NICB）空间多组学队列，利用 MERFISH 空间转录组学、多重免疫荧光和 scRNA-sequencing，在三种黑色素瘤 ICB 方案中以单细胞分辨率分析了超过 1.12 亿个细胞。这些分析揭示了 NICB 肿瘤微环境的完整多细胞空间架构，包括具有生发中心的成熟 TLS、TCF7+ 干样 T 细胞、组织为具有独特细胞间信号回路的空间不同细胞邻域的髓系细胞，以及作为维持这些免疫枢纽的、此前未被识别的基质支架的表达 CCL19/CCL21 的成纤维细胞。我们开发了三种专门构建的计算工具，首次实现对该微环境的全面量化：用于全切片单细胞受体—配体定量的 SCIRA、用于具有分子依据的 TLS 和生发中心结构描绘的 GCSCAN，以及用于在 H&E 图像上自动检测 TLS 的 PathNet-TLS。将这些工具应用于整个队列后，我们界定了区分响应者与非响应者的免疫和基质组成及细胞邻域组织。我们还定量了细胞—细胞相互作用和方案特异的免疫架构，其中 IPI-NIVO 比 NIVO-RELA 引发显著更强的成熟 TLS/生发中心反应。重要的是，GCSCAN 定量的 TLS 和生发中心密度均可对无病生存期进行分层；缺乏生发中心的响应者复发风险升高。开放式顶部光片成像和基于 CODA 的 3D 重建还揭示了标准二维组织病理学中不可见的、相互连通的生发中心—TLS 隧道。这些发现建立了一个从发现到工具的范式，将单细胞肿瘤微环境解析连接到可临床部署的计算病理学，用于跨癌种的生物标志物驱动 NICB 评估。

items.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Dopant Discovery toward Air-Stable Sulfide Solid-State Electrolytes
items.abstract_or_text: Sulfide solid-state electrolytes (SSEs) are highly promising candidates for all-solid-state batteries (ASSBs), but the severe degradation triggered by moisture exposure remains a major obstacle to their large-scale application. Despite compositional doping could effectively enhance the air stability, there is currently no relevant screening strategy to support the efficient exploration of dopants. Herein, we develop an artificial intelligence-assisted dopant screening platform for air-stable sulfide SSEs (LPSC). Retrieval-augmented system combined with large language model could effectively prescreen the dopants that enhance both the ionic conductivity, and interfacial compatibility of the electrolyte. More importantly, the impact of dopants on the air stability of electrolytes was quantified by the minimum Gibbs free energy change () of the hydrolysis reaction, which could be predicted by a composition-based machine learning model. Guided by this strategy, several promising dopants, including BiF3, CoF3, InF3, and SnF4 were successfully identified. As a proof of concept, LPSC-BiF3 electrolyte demonstrates superior air stability, delivering a high ionic conductivity retention of 91% after exposure to air with 10% RH for 6 h. Consequently, the exposed LPSC-BiF3 electrolyte enabled excellent cycling stability in Li-In||NCM811 full cells. The proposed screening strategy significantly promotes the exploration of high-performance dopants for air-stable sulfide SSEs.
items.summary_zh: 工作构建了由检索增强系统、LLM 预筛和组成机器学习模型组成的掺杂剂发现平台，以水解反应的最小 Gibbs 自由能变化量表征硫化物固态电解质 LPSC 的空气稳定性。平台筛出 BiF3、CoF3、InF3 和 SnF4 等候选；其中 LPSC-BiF3 在 10% RH 空气暴露 6 h 后仍保留 91% 的离子电导率，并在 Li-In||NCM811 全电池中显示出良好循环稳定性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是将信息检索、语言模型与材料性质预测连接到实际电池验证的闭环案例，直接针对硫化物电解质的空气敏感瓶颈。现有验证主要集中于 BiF3 及特定湿度、时间和电池构型，其他掺杂剂的泛化性、长期稳定性和全电池适用范围仍需进一步检验。
items.abstract_zh: 硫化物固态电解质（SSEs）是全固态电池（ASSBs）的极具前景候选材料，但由水分暴露触发的严重降解仍是其大规模应用的主要障碍。尽管组成掺杂能够有效提高空气稳定性，目前尚无相关筛选策略支持对掺杂剂进行高效探索。本文开发了一个面向空气稳定硫化物 SSEs（LPSC）的人工智能辅助掺杂剂筛选平台。检索增强系统结合大语言模型可有效预筛同时提高电解质离子电导率和界面相容性的掺杂剂。更重要的是，掺杂剂对电解质空气稳定性的影响由水解反应的最小 Gibbs 自由能变化量（）量化，该量可由基于组成的机器学习模型预测。在该策略指导下，成功识别出包括 BiF3、CoF3、InF3 和 SnF4 在内的若干有前景掺杂剂。作为概念验证，LPSC-BiF3 电解质表现出优异的空气稳定性：在 10% RH 的空气中暴露 6 h 后，仍具有 91% 的高离子电导率保持率。因此，经暴露的 LPSC-BiF3 电解质使 Li-In||NCM811 全电池获得了优异的循环稳定性。所提出的筛选策略显著推动了对高性能、空气稳定硫化物 SSEs 掺杂剂的探索。

items.title: Accelerated discovery of thermostable vaccines using data-efficient AI
items.abstract_or_text: The inherent instability of mRNA- lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) necessitates ultra-cold storage, creating significant barriers for global distribution and limiting their broader application in advanced delivery systems. Solid-state, water-free formulations offer a promising solution by enhancing thermostability and enabling integration into emerging delivery modalities such as microneedle (MN) patches. Prior efforts to stabilize mRNA-LNPs have been constrained by narrow formulation scope and low-throughput screening methods. Here, we introduce AGENT (Algorithm-Guided Experimental design for lipid Nanoparticle Thermostabilization), an AI-driven framework that couples high-throughput experimentation with Bayesian optimization to rapidly identify thermostable mRNA-LNP formulations. Manual exploration of the formulation space required months of screening and yielded suboptimal candidates. In contrast, AGENT extracted maximal information from sparse experimental datasets, enabling efficient formulation optimization in only six iterations completed within one month. Using AGENT, we stabilized mRNA vaccines with diverse LNPs, including those in clinical use, into solid state formulations that retained 100% bioactivity after storage at 37 degree C for over two months. The thermostable vaccines induced antigen-specific IgG and germinal center B cell responses that were non-inferior to those elicited by freshly prepared soluble vaccines. The solid-state formulations were further incorporated into dissolvable MN patches and administered to rodents and nonhuman primates, yielding comparable neutralizing antibody titers compared to conventional intramuscular delivery of fresh vaccines. To our knowledge, this study presents the first demonstration of AI-driven design of thermostable RNA vaccines, offering a scalable, cold-chain-free solution for global immunization. By addressing both stability and delivery challenges, AGENT provides a potentially transformative platform for developing accessible next-generation therapeutics.
items.summary_zh: AGENT 将高通量实验与贝叶斯优化结合，用稀疏配方数据在六轮迭代中发现可在 37 °C 保存超过两个月且保持活性的固态 mRNA-LNP 疫苗配方，并在啮齿动物和非人灵长类中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把配方优化、热稳定性和多种动物免疫证据连接起来，为降低 mRNA 疫苗冷链依赖提供了可检验路径；其临床可用性、长期稳定性和不同抗原的泛化性仍有待人体研究确认。
items.abstract_zh: mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）的固有不稳定性需要超低温储存，对全球分发造成重大障碍，并限制了其在先进递送系统中的更广泛应用。固态无水配方通过增强热稳定性并支持整合到微针（MN）贴片等新兴递送方式中，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。此前稳定 mRNA-LNP 的努力受到配方范围狭窄和低通量筛选方法的限制。在此，我们提出 AGENT（Algorithm-Guided Experimental design for lipid Nanoparticle Thermostabilization），这是一个将高通量实验与贝叶斯优化相结合的 AI 驱动框架，可快速识别热稳定 mRNA-LNP 配方。对配方空间的人工探索需要数月筛选且得到的候选物并不理想。相比之下，AGENT 从稀疏实验数据集中提取最大信息量，仅在一个月内完成的六次迭代中就实现了高效配方优化。利用 AGENT，我们将包括临床使用 LNP 在内、具有不同 LNP 的 mRNA 疫苗稳定为固态配方；这些配方在 37 °C 储存超过两个月后仍保留 100% 生物活性。热稳定疫苗诱导的抗原特异性 IgG 和生发中心 B 细胞应答不劣于新鲜制备液体疫苗所诱导的应答。固态配方还被整合进可溶解 MN 贴片，并给予啮齿动物和非人灵长类；与新鲜疫苗常规肌内注射相比，产生了可比的中和抗体滴度。据我们所知，本研究首次展示了 AI 驱动的热稳定 RNA 疫苗设计，为全球免疫接种提供了一种可扩展、无需冷链的解决方案。通过同时解决稳定性和递送挑战，AGENT 为开发可及的新一代治疗产品提供了一个可能具有变革性的平台。

items.title: Disentangling element‑specific pathways in solvothermal formation of platinum-group metal complex solid solutions
items.abstract_or_text: Platinum‑group metal (PGM) complex solid‑solution nanoparticles exhibit unique catalytic properties due to a homogeneous atomic‑scale distribution of multiple elements within a single crystalline phase. Despite their importance, the mechanisms governing their solvothermal formation remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate the solvothermal synthesis of multicomponent Pt–Ir–Pd–Rh–Ru nanoparticles by in situ powder X‑ray diffraction, enabling time‑resolved monitoring across a wide compositional space of ternary and quaternary alloys. Lattice‑parameter evolution confirms incorporation of all elements into a common fcc phase with a systematic iridium deficiency. Crystallite size correlates with elemental heat of fusion, identifying lattice energy as a key parameter controlling particle growth. Formation pathways are strongly element specific: Pd‑free systems form homogeneous alloys directly, whereas Pd‑containing systems follow a two‑step mechanism involving initial Pd‑rich crystallisation and diffusion‑controlled alloying when Pt is present. Pd without Pt yields inhomogeneous multiphase products, contradicting the assumption that Pd seeding is required for homogeneous PGM alloy formation. Overall, this study demonstrates how in situ X‑ray diffraction can accelerate materials discovery while also providing general mechanistic insight into multicomponent solvothermal alloy formation.
items.summary_zh: 作者用原位粉末 X 射线衍射追踪 Pt–Ir–Pd–Rh–Ru 三元和四元纳米合金的溶剂热形成，发现所有元素进入共同 fcc 相但存在系统性 Ir 缺失，晶粒尺寸与元素熔化热相关。无 Pd 体系可直接形成均匀合金；含 Pd 体系则先结晶为富 Pd 相，在有 Pt 时再经扩散合金化；没有 Pt 的 Pd 体系形成不均匀多相产物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究以时间分辨实验证据拆解多组分 PGM 固溶体的元素特异性形成路径，为催化纳米合金的可控合成提供了机制线索。考察的体系限于给定元素组合和溶剂热条件，催化性能与形成机制之间的直接定量关联尚未在摘要中呈现。
items.abstract_zh: 铂族金属（PGM）复合固溶体纳米颗粒因多种元素在单一晶相中均匀的原子尺度分布而表现出独特催化性质。尽管其重要性突出，控制其溶剂热形成的机制仍知之甚少。本文利用原位粉末 X 射线衍射研究多组分 Pt–Ir–Pd–Rh–Ru 纳米颗粒的溶剂热合成，从而能够在宽广的三元和四元合金组成空间内进行时间分辨监测。晶格参数演化证实所有元素均并入一个共同的 fcc 相，但存在系统性的铱缺失。晶粒尺寸与元素熔化热相关，表明晶格能是控制颗粒生长的关键参数。形成路径具有强烈元素特异性：无 Pd 体系直接形成均匀合金，而含 Pd 体系在有 Pt 时遵循两步机制，包括先形成富 Pd 晶体，随后发生扩散控制的合金化。没有 Pt 的 Pd 则产生不均匀多相产物，这与 Pd 成核是形成均匀 PGM 合金所必需的假设相矛盾。总体而言，本研究展示了原位 X 射线衍射如何加速材料发现，同时也为多组分溶剂热合金形成提供了普遍的机制认识。

items.abstract_or_text: Banger paper from MIT and Sakana AI. They show that self-improving coding agents work. The best part is that their approach, Self-Improvement via Fast Tree-search (SIFT), runs at a tenth of the CPU hours of DGM. They reach 35.1 percent on Polyglot with o3-mini after 30 expansions. DGM reaches 30.7 percent after 80 nodes of tree search. SIFT does it in under 50 CPU hours and under 5 hours of wall clock. The Qwen3-30B configuration runs its full search at 224 CPU hours and 34 of API spend, a tenth of the DGM baseline. The saving comes from where the money goes. Benchmark evaluation is the runtime bottleneck, so an LLM judge ranks candidate self-modifications first and only promising candidates get evaluated.
items.summary_zh: DAIR.AI转述MIT与Sakana AI的SIFT研究：帖文称，该方法以LLM裁判预筛候选自我修改，将完整基准评估集中在更有希望的候选上，并报告了相对DGM更低的计算开销和Polyglot结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这把自我改进智能体的成本瓶颈明确落在评估环节，值得关注其“先判别、后评测”的资源分配思路。具体性能、比较设置和成本数字仍应以原论文为准。
items.abstract_zh: MIT 和 Sakana AI 有一篇很棒的论文。他们展示了自我改进的编程智能体确实有效。最精彩之处是，他们的方法“通过快速树搜索实现自我改进”（SIFT）的 CPU 小时数仅为 DGM 的十分之一。在经过 30 次扩展后，它们以 o3-mini 在 Polyglot 上达到 35.1%；DGM 在 80 个树搜索节点后达到 30.7%。SIFT 用时不足 50 个 CPU 小时、实际时钟时间不足 5 小时。Qwen3-30B 配置完成完整搜索需要 224 个 CPU 小时和 34 的 API 开支，是 DGM 基线的十分之一。节省来自费用的去向：基准评估是运行时瓶颈，因此 LLM 裁判先给候选自我修改排序，只有有希望的候选才会被评估。

items.title: @omarsar0：One of the craziest use cases I’ve found for Jev: verifiers. I am so excited about this that I at least wanted to share
items.abstract_or_text: One of the craziest use cases I’ve found for Jev: verifiers. I am so excited about this that I at least wanted to share the high-level idea. I used Jev to build a custom verifier for the /goal feature in my agent harness. It checks whether the goal is actually complete after every turn, making continuous verification cheap enough to scale. This means I can run more of these verifiers (previously handled by another expensive reasoning model) more frequently to keep the agents on track. System One models are perfect for verification. I think of this as scaling harnesses further by cleverly combining System One and System Two models. This is an insane unlock for long-horizon agents.
items.summary_zh: Omar Sar0分享其工程经验：他称自己用Jev为智能体框架的/goal功能构建了逐轮完成度验证器，以较低成本更频繁地检查目标是否真正完成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：将较便宜的模型用于高频验证、将昂贵推理留给其他环节，是长程智能体中可检验的系统设计假设；这是单个作者的实践报告，尚无公开基准或实现材料支撑其泛化性。
items.abstract_zh: 我发现 Jev 最疯狂的用途之一：验证器。我对此太兴奋了，至少想分享高层想法。我用 Jev 为我的智能体框架的 /goal 功能构建了一个自定义验证器。它在每轮之后检查目标是否实际完成，使得持续验证足够便宜、可以扩展。这意味着我能更频繁运行更多这样的验证器（之前由另一个昂贵的推理模型处理），以让智能体保持在正轨。System One 模型非常适合验证。我把它看作以聪明方式结合 System One 与 System Two 模型，从而进一步扩展智能体框架。这对长程智能体而言是一个惊人的解锁。

items.title: dubTAGs enable on-demand stabilization for tunable and reversible control of endogenous protein levels
items.abstract_or_text: Precise and rapid control over cellular protein levels is essential to dissect complex biological systems. Chemical genetic approaches such as dTAG, in which a target is fused to a degron tag (FKBP12F36V) and degraded upon small molecule-mediated recruitment of E3 ligases, have enabled rapid and tunable control over protein abundance. However, no analogous tool exists to precisely increase protein levels and actively reverse dTAG-mediated degradation. Here, we developed heterobifunctional small molecules (dubTAGs) that stabilize FKBP12F36V-tagged proteins by recruiting endogenous deubiquitinases. Utilizing stem cell-derived cranial neural crest cells (CNCCs) in which the transcription factors SOX9 or TWIST1 are endogenously tagged with FKBP12F36V, we identified OTUB1- or USP7-recruiting heterobifunctional molecules that demonstrated effective target stabilization and ternary complex formation. We demonstrate that dubTAG-mediated protein stabilization is dependent on deubiquitinase recruitment, target-specific, and can tunably and rapidly reverse dTAG-mediated degradation. We applied dubTAGs to assess how stabilizing endogenous SOX9 impacts chromatin accessibility in CNCCs, finding both monotonic and non-monotonic regulatory element responses that are driven by distinct sequence features. dubTAGs are readily applicable tools for investigating the effects of elevated protein levels and tunably reversing targeted degradation, enabling new approaches to study protein dosage effects in development, disease, and therapeutic discovery.
items.summary_zh: dubTAGs 通过招募内源去泛素化酶稳定 FKBP12F36V 标记的内源蛋白，可快速、可逆且可调地抵消 dTAG 降解，并用于研究 SOX9 剂量改变的染色质效应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法补足了化学遗传学中对内源蛋白进行受控上调和逆转降解的工具空白，适合研究剂量效应；其适用范围仍取决于可招募去泛素化酶、靶蛋白和细胞背景。
items.abstract_zh: 对细胞蛋白水平进行精确而快速的控制，对于剖析复杂生物系统至关重要。诸如 dTAG 的化学遗传学方法——其中靶标与 degron 标签（FKBP12F36V）融合，并在小分子介导招募 E3 连接酶后被降解——已实现了对蛋白丰度的快速和可调控制。然而，尚不存在可精确增加蛋白水平并主动逆转 dTAG 介导降解的类似工具。在此，我们开发了异双功能小分子（dubTAGs），其通过招募内源去泛素化酶来稳定 FKBP12F36V 标记的蛋白。利用将转录因子 SOX9 或 TWIST1 在内源位点标记 FKBP12F36V 的干细胞来源颅神经嵴细胞（CNCCs），我们鉴定出招募 OTUB1 或 USP7 的异双功能分子，显示出有效的靶标稳定和三元复合物形成。我们证明，dubTAG 介导的蛋白稳定依赖去泛素化酶招募、具有靶标特异性，并且可以可调且快速地逆转 dTAG 介导的降解。我们应用 dubTAGs 评估稳定内源 SOX9 如何影响 CNCCs 中的染色质可及性，发现单调和非单调的调控元件响应，这些响应由不同的序列特征驱动。dubTAGs 是易于应用的工具，可研究升高蛋白水平的效应并可调地逆转靶向降解，从而为研究发育、疾病和治疗发现中的蛋白剂量效应提供新方法。
items.author_line: Guharajan S, Song X, Wu Q, Sengupta S, Wei W, Xiong Y, Jin J, Naqvi S

items.title: An atlas of transcription factor cooperation reveals how motif readers shape regulatory output
items.abstract_or_text: Regulatory motifs are conventionally associated with named transcription factors (TFs), yet a motif label need not identify the protein that reads the sequence or the regulatory consequence that follows in a given cell. We analyzed 1,552 TF binding datasets in 10 cell types using ARES, a multi-agent system that tests competing mechanisms of TF-motif dependencies in a specific cellular context against multi-omic data. We found that the inferred mechanisms converged on three operating routes: direct sequence recognition, protein-mediated recruitment or exclusion, and regulatory context. Importantly, the predictive motifs of the target TF binding were read by their conventionally "canonical" TFs in only one third of resolved dependencies, and these "canonical" TFs were expressed much less often than the inferred readers. Furthermore, we observed that motif similarity was associated with shared regulatory region type but not shared transcriptional outcome, whereas reader identity was associated with both and the only feature among the examined associated with outcome. In validation case studies where an inferred reader was perturbed, target TF occupancy fell in proportion to reader binding before perturbation, and a natural variant disrupting the predictive motif altered target TF binding at every intermediate step of the inferred mechanism. These observations were further supported by single-cell perturbation, in vitro cooperativity and evolutionary constraint. Together, these results separate motif identity from reader identity and regulatory output, suggesting that a motif acts as an address whose regulatory consequence is shaped in trans by the protein that interprets it.
items.summary_zh: ARES 对 10 种细胞类型的 1,552 个 TF 结合数据集整合多组学推断，提出基序读取者而非基序标签更能关联调控输出，并以扰动、单细胞和体外证据支持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该图谱挑战了“一个基序对应一个规范 TF”的简化解释，并将多组学推断连接到实验案例；所推断机制及其跨细胞类型泛化性仍需逐一进行直接验证。
items.abstract_zh: 调控基序通常与具名转录因子（TF）相关联，但基序标签并不一定能确定在特定细胞中读取该序列的蛋白，或随后产生的调控后果。我们使用 ARES 分析了 10 种细胞类型中的 1,552 个 TF 结合数据集；ARES 是一个多智能体系统，可针对特定细胞背景中 TF—基序依赖关系的竞争性机制，以多组学数据进行检验。我们发现，推断的机制汇聚为三条运行路径：直接序列识别、蛋白介导的招募或排斥，以及调控背景。重要的是，在已解析依赖关系中，靶 TF 结合的预测性基序仅有三分之一由传统的“规范”TF 读取，而且这些“规范”TF 的表达频率远低于推断的读取者。此外，我们观察到，基序相似性与共享调控区域类型相关，但与共享转录输出无关；而读取者身份同时与二者相关，并且是在所检验特征中唯一与输出相关的特征。在对推断读取者进行扰动的验证案例中，靶 TF 占据量的下降程度与扰动前读取者结合量成比例；一个破坏预测性基序的天然变异改变了所推断机制每个中间步骤中的靶 TF 结合。单细胞扰动、体外协同性和进化约束进一步支持了这些观察结果。总体而言，这些结果将基序身份与读取者身份和调控输出区分开来，提示基序如同一个地址，其调控后果由反式作用的解读蛋白塑造。
items.author_line: Xiong H, Liu J, Wang W

items.title: OpenLipid: a large language model workflow for targeted analysis of DIA mass spectrometry data in lipidomics
items.abstract_or_text: Mass spectrometry has become a central technology for lipidomics, with data-independent acquisition (DIA) enabling broad and reproducible sampling of lipid signals. However, the multiplexed fragment-ion spectra in DIA data complicate lipid identification. Here, we introduce OpenLipid, a large language model (LLM)-based workflow for targeted DIA lipidomics. Using assay libraries built from data-dependent acquisition (DDA) results, OpenLipid directly evaluates extracted ion chromatograms (XICs) from DIA data in a zero-shot setting to identify target lipid peaks and generate human-readable rationales for individual lipid identification decisions. We benchmarked OpenLipid against manual annotations across four datasets comprising human plasma and mouse feces analyzed in positive and negative ionization modes. The plasma assay libraries contained 199 target lipids in positive mode and 147 in negative mode. The fecal assay libraries contained 181 target lipids in positive mode and 264 in negative mode. At a 5% false discovery rate (FDR) threshold, OpenLipid identified 110 (55.3%) and 28 (19.0%) library targets in plasma and 130 (71.8%) and 84 (31.8%) in feces, in positive and negative ionization modes, respectively. OpenLipid achieved an overall identification rate comparable to that of DIAMetAlyzer (57.8%, 19.7%, 89.0%, and 17.8% across the corresponding datasets) and substantially higher than that of untargeted MS-DIAL DIA analysis (12.6%, 0.0%, 47.5%, and 0.0%) on the same assay-library targets. LLM-derived chromatographic features also enabled supervised discrimination between correct and incorrect candidate peak groups for target lipids, with median cross-validation average precision values of 0.838-0.912. Together, these results demonstrate that OpenLipid is an effective LLM-based workflow for FDR-controlled targeted analysis of DIA lipidomics data.
items.summary_zh: OpenLipid 使用 LLM 零样本判读 DIA 脂质组 XIC，并在四个血浆和粪便数据集上以人工标注为参照，达到与 DIAMetAlyzer 相近的 FDR 控制靶向鉴定率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作将 LLM 推理引入可审阅的 DIA 靶向脂质识别，并报告跨物种、正负离子模式的基准；结果限于既有 DDA assay library 和人工注释参照，不能替代独立结构确认。
items.abstract_zh: 质谱已成为脂质组学的核心技术，数据非依赖采集（DIA）可对脂质信号进行广泛且可重复的采样。然而，DIA 数据中多重化的碎片离子谱使脂质鉴定变得复杂。在此，我们提出 OpenLipid，这是一个用于靶向 DIA 脂质组学的基于大语言模型（LLM）的工作流。利用由数据依赖采集（DDA）结果建立的 assay libraries，OpenLipid 在零样本设置中直接评估 DIA 数据中的提取离子色谱图（XICs），以识别目标脂质峰，并为单个脂质鉴定决策生成可供人阅读的理由。我们针对四个数据集，将 OpenLipid 与人工注释进行基准比较；这些数据集包括以正、负离子模式分析的人血浆和小鼠粪便。血浆 assay libraries 在正离子模式下包含 199 个目标脂质，在负离子模式下包含 147 个。粪便 assay libraries 在正离子模式下包含 181 个目标脂质，在负离子模式下包含 264 个。在 5% false discovery rate（FDR）阈值下，OpenLipid 在血浆中分别于正、负离子模式识别出 110 个（55.3%）和 28 个（19.0%）library targets，在粪便中分别识别出 130 个（71.8%）和 84 个（31.8%）。OpenLipid 的总体鉴定率与 DIAMetAlyzer 相当（对应四个数据集分别为 57.8%、19.7%、89.0% 和 17.8%），并在同一 assay-library targets 上显著高于非靶向 MS-DIAL DIA 分析（12.6%、0.0%、47.5% 和 0.0%）。LLM 导出的色谱特征还可对目标脂质的正确和错误候选峰组进行监督式区分，中位交叉验证 average precision 为 0.838–0.912。总体而言，这些结果表明 OpenLipid 是一个有效的、基于 LLM 的工作流，可对 DIA 脂质组学数据进行 FDR 控制的靶向分析。
items.author_line: Li J, Rost H

items.title: An Interpretable EEG Machine Learning Prototype for Alzheimers Disease Classification
items.abstract_or_text: Resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) can capture the slowing of neural oscillations associated with Alzheimers disease (AD), but many machine-learning studies remain difficult to inspect, reproduce, or test. This study developed an interpretable, subject-level AD versus healthy-control classifier from the dataset OpenNeuro ds004504 and deployed it as a public research prototype. Preprocessed eyes-closed EEG recordings from 36 people with AD and 29 healthy controls were analysed. Welch power spectral density estimates were used to generate absolute and relative bandpower summaries, theta/alpha and delta/alpha ratios, a slow/fast ratio, and signal-level descriptors. Five-fold stratified cross-validation compared two Random Forest configurations, EEG Logistic Regression, an age-only baseline, and an EEG-plus-age model. EEG Logistic Regression gave the strongest mean fold-wise performance: accuracy 0.846, balanced accuracy 0.848, F1 score 0.849, and ROC-AUC 0.948. Age alone was near chance, while adding age did not improve the EEG-only model. The feature pattern was consistent with AD-related EEG slowing, including higher slow-wave-related ratios and lower relative alpha power. The trained pipeline was deployed as a Gradio application on Hugging Face Spaces. The result is a reproducible research and educational prototype, not a clinical diagnostic device, and requires external validation before any clinical interpretation.
items.summary_zh: 基于 OpenNeuro ds004504 的可解释静息态 EEG 原型，在 36 名 AD 患者与 29 名健康对照的五折交叉验证中，EEG Logistic Regression 报告 ROC-AUC 0.948，并公开部署为研究演示。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据、特征和公开原型使结果具有可复现的研究价值；样本小且仅内部交叉验证，作者明确说明其不是临床诊断设备，必须经外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 静息态脑电图（EEG）能够捕捉与 Alzheimer’s disease（AD）相关的神经振荡减慢，但许多机器学习研究仍难以检查、复现或检验。本研究从数据集 OpenNeuro ds004504 开发了一个可解释的、受试者层面的 AD 对健康对照分类器，并将其部署为公开研究原型。分析了来自 36 名 AD 患者和 29 名健康对照的、经预处理的闭眼 EEG 记录。使用 Welch power spectral density estimates 生成绝对和相对 bandpower 汇总、theta/alpha 和 delta/alpha 比值、slow/fast 比值及信号层面描述符。五折分层交叉验证比较了两种 Random Forest 配置、EEG Logistic Regression、仅年龄基线和 EEG-plus-age 模型。EEG Logistic Regression 给出最强的平均折间性能：accuracy 0.846、balanced accuracy 0.848、F1 score 0.849 和 ROC-AUC 0.948。仅年龄的表现接近随机，而加入年龄未改善仅 EEG 模型。特征模式与 AD 相关 EEG 减慢一致，包括更高的慢波相关比值和更低的相对 alpha power。训练完成的管线被部署为 Hugging Face Spaces 上的 Gradio 应用。该结果是可复现的研究和教育原型，而非临床诊断设备，在进行任何临床解释前需要外部验证。
items.author_line: DAS A, Chakravarty A

items.title: Per-Stage Controls and Failure Modes in a Co-Folding Virtual Screening Cascade for the Keap1–Nrf2 Interaction
items.abstract_or_text: Virtual-screening cascades assembled from co-folding and learned-affinity models are now routine, and each stage is usually trusted on the strength of its own score. We measured, stage by stage, whether those scores carry the information a practitioner would attribute to them, using the Keap1–Nrf2 protein–protein interaction and a 130,793-compound make-on-demand library as the test bed. Most measurements are negative, and none of the failure modes is specific to one of the two models tested. Two independently developed affinity models order activity-cliff pairs above chance (about 68% of 181 pairs) but carry no information about the size of the potency gap, and both couple to molecular weight; the built-in molecular-weight correction rescales without de-biasing. Neither model resolves enantiomers, including the model that generates an explicit high-confidence three-dimensional pose. Pose-model confidence is only weakly informative about geometric validity, so an explicit validity check is required rather than optional. Training-free guidance is required for stereochemical fidelity in pose generation, and diffusion steps can be halved without detectable loss. A seeded matched-decoy gate validates the pose-and-energy stage where no single physicochemical descriptor does, and the pose model reproduces all five co-crystal references below 2 Å, three of them released after its training cutoff. Single-structure MM-GBSA ordering is not validated by ensemble refinement, and the two solvation models disagree both on the ordering and on which candidates are separable at all. The control suite is released as a reusable artifact.
items.summary_zh: 工作以 Keap1–Nrf2 蛋白–蛋白相互作用和 130,793 个可按需合成化合物为测试床，逐阶段审计共折叠、学习型亲和力、构象和溶剂化评分组成的虚拟筛选流程。结果显示亲和力模型难以量化效价差、存在分子量耦合且不能区分对映体；构象置信度对几何正确性的信息量有限。作者提出并发布了含匹配诱饵门控等测试的可复用控制套件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究不把模型分数直接等同于药物发现证据，而是系统揭示虚拟筛选级联的失效模式，并给出可操作的阶段性控制。结论来自一个靶点、两种模型和特定测试集，是否可外推至其他靶标、化学空间和实验活性测定仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 由共折叠和学习型亲和力模型构成的虚拟筛选级联如今已成常规，而每个阶段通常都因其自身分数而被信任。我们逐阶段测量这些分数是否确实携带实践者通常赋予它们的信息，以 Keap1–Nrf2 蛋白–蛋白相互作用和一个包含 130,793 个可按需合成化合物的化合物库为测试床。大多数测量结果为阴性，且没有一种失效模式是所测试两种模型中某一种所特有的。两个独立开发的亲和力模型都能以高于随机的水平对活性悬崖对进行排序（181 对中约 68%），但并不携带效价差距大小的信息，且二者都与分子量耦合；内置的分子量校正只能重缩放而不能去偏。两种模型均不能分辨对映体，包括能够生成显式高置信度三维构象的模型。构象模型的置信度对几何有效性仅有较弱的信息量，因此显式有效性检查是必需的，而非可选项。构象生成中的立体化学保真度需要无需训练的引导，且在未检测到损失的情况下可将扩散步数减半。一个带种子的匹配诱饵门控验证了构象与能量阶段，而没有任何单一物理化学描述符能够做到这一点；该构象模型还能以低于 2 Å 的误差重现全部五个共晶参考，其中三个在其训练截止日期之后发布。单一结构 MM-GBSA 排序未被系综精修验证，两种溶剂化模型在排序以及哪些候选物根本可分离上均不一致。该控制套件作为可复用工件发布。
items.author_line: Huynh-Duc Le

items.title: Mechanical State Selection in Mechanochemical Bond Activation.
items.abstract_or_text: Mechanochemical reactivity provides a distinctive mode of energy input, wherein mechanical force performs work on molecular structures to access reactivity beyond conventional thermal activation. Yet a fundamental understanding of how transient mechanical impacts translate into productive molecular activation remains lacking, particularly under the stochastic conditions of ball milling. By promoting direct homolytic bond scission, mechanoradical chemistry provides an ideal platform to interrogate the role of mechanical force in triggering chemical reactions. However, the resulting highly reactive radical species are often short-lived and elusive, making their formation and reactivity difficult to quantify. Here we use a mechanoradical-chain C-S coupling reaction to amplify otherwise transient initiation events into a measurable kinetic response. Time-resolved kinetics reveal a pronounced force-dependent induction period, while theoretical calculations show that productive C-I homolysis requires a specific loading trajectory. These findings indicate that mechanical force does not simply promote bond cleavage in proportion to its magnitude; rather, individual impacts sample a distribution of mechanical states, with only a small subset being competent for chemical activation. This selective sampling of mechanically competent states provides a mechanistic basis that controls the initiation, propagation and extinction of mechanoradical chains, enabling sustained out-of-equilibrium radical reactivity under intermittent mechanical driving, including with otherwise inaccessible insoluble poly(disulfides) in a diffusion-limited setting.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以 mechanoradical-chain C-S 偶联放大短寿命机械自由基的起始事件，并结合时间分辨动力学与理论计算，分析球磨中机械冲击如何触发化学键活化。结果表明有效 C-I 均裂需要特定加载轨迹，球磨冲击仅有少数机械状态能启动化学活化；这一状态选择控制了自由基链的起始、传播和终止。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究为间歇机械驱动下的非平衡自由基反应提供了可检验的机制框架，也说明机械化学的反应性不能仅按施力大小理解。证据来自特定 C-S 偶联和计算加载轨迹，对其他机械化学体系的普适性仍有待实验证实。
items.abstract_zh: 机械化学反应性提供了一种独特的能量输入方式，其中机械力对分子结构做功，从而获得超越常规热活化的反应性。然而，特别是在球磨的随机条件下，人们仍缺乏对瞬态机械冲击如何转化为有效分子活化的基础理解。通过促进直接均裂断键，机械自由基化学为探究机械力触发化学反应的作用提供了理想平台。然而，所得高反应性自由基物种通常寿命很短且难以捕捉，使其形成和反应性难以定量。本文使用一种 mechanoradical-chain C-S 偶联反应，将原本瞬态的引发事件放大为可测量的动力学响应。时间分辨动力学显示出显著的力依赖诱导期，而理论计算表明，有效的 C-I 均裂需要特定的加载轨迹。这些发现表明，机械力并非按其大小成比例地促进断键；相反，单次冲击会采样一组机械状态，只有其中很小一部分能够胜任化学活化。这种对机械胜任状态的选择性采样提供了一个机制基础，它控制机械自由基链的引发、传播和终止，使间歇机械驱动下持续的非平衡自由基反应成为可能，包括在扩散受限环境中原本难以进入的、不溶性 poly(disulfides) 的反应。
items.author_line: Taoyong Wang, Hao Li, Xuanyang Ni, KaKing Yan

items.title: Screening Natural and Modified Nucleobases to Create Alkylation-Resistant Nucleic Acids Toward Sensing Applications
items.abstract_or_text: Alkylating agents play critical roles in medicine and chemical defense but also pose significant hazards by modifying DNA and disrupting cellular function. Their reliable detection is therefore critical, yet current analytical methods are often limited by poor selectivity, need for extensive sample preparation, or poor compatibility with complex matrices. Nucleic acid sensors, such as aptamers, offer a promising route to achieve selective sensing. However, alkylation of nucleobases can compromise DNA three-dimensional structure and binding abilities. To address this limitation, we sought to develop DNA sequences that are resistant to alkylation. We first evaluated the reactivity of modified nucleobases toward a panel of alkylating agents. Although the N7 position 2 of guanosine and N3 position of adenosine have been reported to be among the primary alkylation sites, their analogues 7-deaza-2′-deoxyguanosine and 3-deaza-2′-deoxyadensoine were still found to be reactive. In contrast, 7-deaza-2′-deoxyinosine and 7-deaza-2′-deoxyadenosine were resistant to all alkylating agents tested. Using these resistant nucleobases as substitutes for all guanosine and adenosine residues, respectively, we screened polymerases and found that Therminator DNA Polymerase enabled enzymatic synthesis of fully alkylation-resistant DNA. This work establishes a chemical framework for the development of robust, DNA-based sensors for alkylating agents in biomedical and defense applications.
items.summary_zh: 研究筛查天然和修饰核碱基对多种烷基化剂的反应性，发现 7-deaza-2′-deoxyinosine 与 7-deaza-2′-deoxyadenosine 对所有测试烷基化剂均具抗性。将其分别替代 DNA 中全部鸟苷和腺苷残基后，作者筛到可合成完全抗烷基化 DNA 的 Therminator DNA Polymerase。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作从核碱基化学和酶促合成两端建立了耐烷基化 DNA 的实现路线，可能提升复杂基质中核酸传感器的耐受性。摘要未给出具体传感器性能、序列依赖性或复杂样品中的选择性数据，应用价值仍需在完整器件中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 烷基化剂在医学和化学防御中发挥关键作用，但也会通过修饰 DNA 并扰乱细胞功能而造成重大危害。因此，对它们进行可靠检测至关重要，但当前分析方法常受限于选择性差、需要大量样品前处理或与复杂基质兼容性差。核酸传感器，如适配体，为实现选择性传感提供了有前景的途径。然而，核碱基的烷基化会损害 DNA 的三维结构和结合能力。为解决这一限制，我们试图开发耐烷基化的 DNA 序列。我们首先评估了修饰核碱基对一组烷基化剂的反应性。尽管据报道鸟苷的 N7 位点2 和腺苷的 N3 位点是主要烷基化位点之一，它们的类似物 7-deaza-2′-deoxyguanosine 和 3-deaza-2′-deoxyadensoine 仍被发现具有反应性。相比之下，7-deaza-2′-deoxyinosine 和 7-deaza-2′-deoxyadenosine 对所有测试的烷基化剂均具有抗性。以这些耐受核碱基分别替代所有鸟苷和腺苷残基后，我们筛查聚合酶并发现 Therminator DNA Polymerase 能够酶促合成完全耐烷基化的 DNA。这项工作为开发用于生物医学和防御应用的稳健 DNA 传感器提供了化学框架。
items.author_line: Olamilekan Joseph Ibukun, Makenzie R. Walk, Jennifer M. Heemstra

items.title: Hydridoaluminastibanes: A New Class of Al–Sb Bonded Main-Group Compound
items.abstract_or_text: Reactions of an Al(I) center with Sb–Cl, Bi–Cl and, notably, Sb–H reagents afford a family of Al(III) complexes featuring structurally characterized, pnictogen–halide and –hydride bonds. The Sb–H reaction is particularly striking, simultaneously forging Al–Sb and Al–H bonds to give the first hydridoaluminastibane establishing the previously unknown Al(Sb)(H) functional group. These results introduce pnictogen hydride oxidative addition as a new strategy for Al–Sb bond formation and expands the reactivity landscape of hydrostibination.
items.summary_zh: 作者使 Al(I) 中心分别与 Sb–Cl、Bi–Cl 和 Sb–H 试剂反应，得到含 pnictogen–halide 或 pnictogen–hydride 键的结构表征 Al(III) 配合物。Sb–H 反应同时构建 Al–Sb 和 Al–H 键，首次获得 hydridoaluminastibane，并建立此前未知的 Al(Sb)(H) 官能团。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究扩展了主族 Al–Sb 键构建和 hydrostibination 的反应性图谱，并提出 pnictogen hydride oxidative addition 这一合成策略。摘要聚焦结构与反应发现，尚未说明该官能团的反应范围、稳定性边界或功能性应用。
items.abstract_zh: Al(I) 中心与 Sb–Cl、Bi–Cl，尤其是 Sb–H 试剂的反应，得到了一系列 Al(III) 配合物，其中具有经结构表征的 pnictogen–halide 和 –hydride 键。Sb–H 反应尤其引人注目：它同时形成 Al–Sb 和 Al–H 键，得到首个 hydridoaluminastibane，确立了此前未知的 Al(Sb)(H) 官能团。这些结果引入了 pnictogen hydride oxidative addition 作为形成 Al–Sb 键的新策略，并扩展了 hydrostibination 的反应性图谱。

items.abstract_or_text: I keep telling the new wave of AI computer scientists who embrace the "I prove it Lean, so it is correct" that you cannot talk about code correctness without a formal semantics of the PL. Let me make this point by means of a simple example: 1. What does this program evaluate to? 2. Prove it in Lean. Before attempting 2, do yourself a favor and run it with gcc and clang, various optimization levels, and see what you get. Morale: You cannot even define the notion of correctness without a formal semantics.

items.title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Colorectal Cancer Symptom Extraction from MIMIC-IV Clinical Notes
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Much of the symptom burden in colorectal cancer (CRC) patients is documented in unstructured discharge-note narrative, and manual extraction is not scalable. Whether large language models (LLMs) outperform rule-based and named entity recognition (NER) methods has not been rigorously benchmarked. Objective: To benchmark rule-based, NER, and zero-shot LLM methods for extracting 46 cancer-related symptoms from CRC discharge notes against an adjudicated ground truth. Methods: We analyzed 2,704 discharge notes from CRC patients in MIMIC-IV. A 46-symptom target list was built from the Memorial Symptom Assessment Scale and the EORTC QLQ-CR29. Four approaches -- dictionary-based rule matching, pretrained clinical NER, and zero-shot Claude Haiku and Gemini 3.5 Flash -- plus two hybrid variants (LLM output with post-hoc rule-based negation filtering) were evaluated against a 200-note gold standard adjudicated by two raters (pooled kappa=0.71, macro kappa=0.49), using Macro/Micro F1, precision, and recall. Results: Gemini 3.5 Flash performed best (Macro F1=0.70, Micro F1=0.86, Macro Precision=0.74), followed by Claude Haiku (Macro F1=0.63, Macro Recall=0.71); both substantially outperformed rule-based (Macro F1=0.44) and NER (Macro F1=0.38) methods. Post-hoc negation filtering paradoxically degraded LLM performance (Gemini+Hybrid Macro F1=0.58; Claude+Hybrid Macro F1=0.54) by overriding correct predictions through rigid, fixed-window matching. Conclusions: Zero-shot LLMs substantially outperform rule-based and NER approaches for CRC symptom extraction; post-hoc negation correction should not be applied to LLM outputs without syntactic scope validation. Implications for Practice: Zero-shot LLM extraction offers a scalable, accurate alternative to manual chart review and traditional NLP pipelines for oncology symptom surveillance, without institution-specific rule development or model training.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提供了经双人裁决金标准比较的临床文本抽取基准，并指出固定窗口否定规则可能损害 LLM 输出；结果来自单一公开数据库和 200 份金标准记录，尚不能直接外推至真实临床部署。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）患者的大部分症状负担记录在非结构化出院记录叙述中，人工提取不可扩展。大语言模型（LLMs）是否优于基于规则和命名实体识别（NER）的方法，尚未得到严格基准评估。目的：针对 CRC 出院记录中 46 种癌症相关症状的提取，以经裁决的真值为参照，对基于规则、NER 和零样本 LLM 方法进行基准比较。方法：我们分析了 MIMIC-IV 中 CRC 患者的 2,704 份出院记录。由 Memorial Symptom Assessment Scale 和 EORTC QLQ-CR29 建立 46 种症状目标清单。以两名评定者裁决的 200 份记录金标准为参照（pooled kappa = 0.71，macro kappa = 0.49），评估了四种方法——基于词典的规则匹配、预训练临床 NER、零样本 Claude Haiku 和 Gemini 3.5 Flash——以及两种混合变体（LLM 输出结合事后基于规则的否定过滤），指标为 Macro/Micro F1、precision 和 recall。结果：Gemini 3.5 Flash 表现最佳（Macro F1 = 0.70，Micro F1 = 0.86，Macro Precision = 0.74），其次是 Claude Haiku（Macro F1 = 0.63，Macro Recall = 0.71）；二者均显著优于基于规则（Macro F1 = 0.44）和 NER（Macro F1 = 0.38）方法。事后否定过滤反而降低了 LLM 性能（Gemini+Hybrid Macro F1 = 0.58；Claude+Hybrid Macro F1 = 0.54），原因是刚性的固定窗口匹配覆盖了正确预测。结论：零样本 LLM 在 CRC 症状抽取方面显著优于基于规则和 NER 的方法；未经句法范围验证，不应将事后否定校正应用于 LLM 输出。实践意义：零样本 LLM 抽取为肿瘤症状监测提供了可扩展且准确的替代方案，无需机构特异的规则开发或模型训练。

items.title: Safety, Feasibility, and Preliminary Clinical Findings of an Oral Polypore Fungi Combination with Mild-to-Moderate COVID-19: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Phase I Clinical Trial
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Use of fungal mycelia, which have innate immunity-enhancing and antiviral properties, constitutes a novel early-wave, low-cost, at-home strategy in the early critical months of an outbreak when treatments or mass medical countermeasures are not yet available and the public health recommendations advise quarantining at home. Methods: We evaluated safety and feasibility of a fungal mycelial combination (Fomitopsis officinalis and Trametes versicolor, FoTv) for treatment of COVID-19 and explored its antiviral effects and potential to reduce symptoms. In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled (26 FoTv, 24 Placebo), dual site (UCSD/UCLA medical centers) clinical trial conducted under an active FDA Investigational New Drug (IND) application, we examined non-hospitalized patients diagnosed with mild-to-moderate COVID-19 [≤] 96 hours, and experienced symptom onset [≤] nine days, before enrollment. Results: FoTv was safe, well-tolerated, and feasible for COVID-19 treatment. Mean values for renal, hepatic, and coagulation markers for both the FoTv and Placebo groups remained within normal levels. Unlike the Placebo, the FoTv group exhibited a minor reduction in estimated glomerular filtration rate across the treatment period, but both groups were equally likely to transition from normal to abnormal levels across the treatment period. Treatment adherence was high (97% FoTv, 95% Placebo) and dropout was low (0% FoTv, 4% Placebo). Exploratory analyses indicated that FoTv significantly reduced the number and severity of symptoms, particularly sore throat/cough, as well as the COVID-19 biomarker, C-reactive protein. A complementary in vitro study indicated that FoTv reduced SARS-CoV-2 (pseudovirus) cellular infection. Conclusions: FoTv was safe, feasible, reduced viral cellular infection, and may reduce symptoms of COVID-19 associated with viral transmission. In our recent companion clinical trial, examining FoTv as a COVID vaccine adjunct, we observed a significant reduction in short-term vaccine side effects while preserving, and potentially increasing long-term anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibody levels over six months (Saxe et al., 2026, BMC Immunology). Taken together, these studies elucidate a blueprint for a novel two-phase public health pandemic intervention. This blueprint involves use of a botanical immunomodulatory product, during the early critical months of an outbreak and, once vaccines become available, to improve their uptake and effectiveness. Trial Registration: Clinicaltrials.gov registration:NCT04667247.

items.abstract_zh: 背景：使用具有增强先天免疫和抗病毒特性的真菌菌丝，在暴发早期关键月份——彼时治疗手段或大规模医疗对策尚不可获得且公共卫生建议居家隔离——构成一种新颖、低成本、居家使用的策略。方法：我们评估了真菌菌丝组合（Fomitopsis officinalis 和 Trametes versicolor，FoTv）用于治疗 COVID-19 的安全性和可行性，并探索其抗病毒效应及降低症状的潜力。在一项依据有效 FDA Investigational New Drug（IND）申请开展的、双中心（UCSD/UCLA medical centers）、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照临床试验中（26 例 FoTv、24 例 Placebo），我们研究了非住院轻至中度 COVID-19 患者；患者在确诊后 ≤ 96 小时、症状起始后 ≤ 九天入组。结果：FoTv 对 COVID-19 治疗安全、耐受性良好且可行。FoTv 组和 Placebo 组的肾脏、肝脏和凝血指标平均值在治疗期均保持于正常范围内。与 Placebo 不同，FoTv 组在治疗期内 estimated glomerular filtration rate 轻度下降，但两组在治疗期内从正常转为异常的可能性相同。治疗依从性高（FoTv 97%，Placebo 95%），脱落率低（FoTv 0%，Placebo 4%）。探索性分析表明，FoTv 显著降低了症状数量和严重程度，尤其是咽痛/咳嗽，并降低了 COVID-19 生物标志物 C-reactive protein。补充体外研究表明，FoTv 降低 SARS-CoV-2（pseudovirus）细胞感染。结论：FoTv 安全、可行、降低病毒细胞感染，并可能减轻与病毒传播相关的 COVID-19 症状。在我们近期的配套临床试验中，研究 FoTv 作为 COVID 疫苗佐剂时，我们观察到其显著降低短期疫苗副作用，同时在六个月内保持并可能提高长期 anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibody levels（Saxe et al., 2026, BMC Immunology）。综合来看，这些研究阐明了一种新颖的两阶段公共卫生大流行干预蓝图。该蓝图涉及在暴发早期关键月份使用一种 botanical immunomodulatory product，并在疫苗可获得后用于改善其接种和有效性。试验注册：Clinicaltrials.gov registration:NCT04667247。

items.title: Dynamic Parameter Screening for Accelerated Mechanistic Analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Mechanistic studies are essential for the continued advancement of the chemical sciences however; classical approaches remain laborious and material intensive. Graphical reaction analysis techniques such as RPKA and VTNA have substantially reduced this burden, yet the time and resources required to comprehensively study increasingly complex reactions remain high. Medium- and high-throughput batch and flow kinetic methods have been developed to further streamline data acquisition, but their widespread adoption is limited by the need for specialized equipment or expertise. Here we introduce dynamic parameter screening (DPS), in which a single batch reaction is monitored continuously while sequential reagent and catalyst additions are used to probe kinetic impacts of multiple species within one experimental setup. Using the palladium-catalyzed Kumada–Tamao–Corriu cross-coupling as a model system, we compared DPS with traditional one-factor-at-a-time approach across three catalytic systems (PdCl2(dppf)·CH2Cl2, PEPPSI-iPr, and XPhos Pd G2). DPS afforded essentially identical qualitative and quantitative (kinetic modeling) conclusions except for the case of XPhos Pd G2. This latter system exhibited multiple kinetic regimes where the traditional approach revealed the global impact of reagent concentrations, whereas DPS provided complementary, higher-resolution insight into reagent effects within a specific kinetic regime. The insights obtained from DPS guided a simple slow-dosing strategy that markedly improved reaction rates even at reduced catalyst loadings. DPS therefore provides a practical, low-barrier route to high-resolution kinetic information that is fully compatible with conventional modeling, broadening access to mechanistic understanding in resource-limited settings.
items.summary_zh: 作者提出动态参数筛选（DPS）：在单次批式反应连续监测过程中，依次加入试剂和催化剂，同时探测多种物种的动力学影响。以 PdCl2(dppf)·CH2Cl2、PEPPSI-iPr 和 XPhos Pd G2 催化的 Kumada–Tamao–Corriu 偶联为例，DPS 通常与逐一变量法给出一致的定性和定量结论，并据此提出低催化剂负载下的慢加料提速策略。
items.why_it_matters_zh: DPS 有望以常规反应设备降低机制研究的时间和物料成本，同时保留可与传统动力学建模衔接的实验读出。XPhos Pd G2 出现多动力学区间，说明该方法反映的是局部条件效应，复杂反应仍应与传统全局扰动实验互补使用。
items.abstract_zh: 机制研究对化学科学的持续进步至关重要，但经典方法仍然费时且消耗大量物料。RPKA 和 VTNA 等图形反应分析技术已大幅减轻这一负担，但全面研究日益复杂反应所需的时间和资源仍然很高。中高通量批式和流动动力学方法已被开发以进一步简化数据获取，但其广泛采用受到专用设备或专业知识需求的限制。本文介绍动态参数筛选（DPS），即连续监测单次批式反应，同时通过依次加入试剂和催化剂来探测多个物种的动力学影响。我们以 palladium-catalyzed Kumada–Tamao–Corriu cross-coupling 为模型体系，在 PdCl2(dppf)·CH2Cl2、PEPPSI-iPr 和 XPhos Pd G2 三个催化体系中比较 DPS 与传统逐一变量方法。除 XPhos Pd G2 的情况外，DPS 给出了本质上相同的定性和定量（动力学建模）结论。后一个体系表现出多个动力学区间：传统方法揭示了试剂浓度的全局影响，而 DPS 则对特定动力学区间内试剂效应提供了互补且更高分辨率的洞见。DPS 获得的洞见指导了一种简单的慢加料策略，即使在降低催化剂负载量时也显著提高了反应速率。因此，DPS 为获取高分辨率动力学信息提供了一种实用、低门槛且与常规建模完全兼容的途径，拓宽了资源有限条件下获得机制认识的机会。

items.title: Polymer-Assisted One-Dimensional Dissolution in N‑Methylformamide Unlocks Highly Ordered Hybrid Bragg-Stack Clay-Poly(Ethylene Glycol) Oxygen Barriers
items.abstract_or_text: One-dimensional (1D) dissolution is a gentle and thermodynamically driven process that enables the spontaneous and utter delamination of layered materials into nematic suspensions of individual high aspect ratio nanosheets. This process is primarily known and extensively explored for aqueous systems. Examples of 1D dissolution in organic solvents are scarce and require selected organocations or complexation of the interlayer cation. This work demonstrates synergistic delamination of synthetic sodium fluorohectorite (NaHec; Na0.5inter [Li0.5Mg2.5]oct tet O10F2) in N-methylformamide (NMF) using poly (ethylene glycol) (PEG), which concomitantly acts as a complexing agent driving delamination and as the polymer matrix for a composite. Upon spray coating, the polymer is directly incorporated into a highly ordered hybrid Bragg-stack nanocomposite. The performance as a gas barrier was investigated for a range of PEG chain lengths [MW = 200, 400, 1500, 10000 g mol-1] using O2‑transmission rate measurements. With increasing MW, substantially reduced oxygen permeabilities (23°C, 75% r.h.) were observed, reaching values as low as 0.029 cm3 µm m‑2 d‑1 bar‑1, demonstrating the power of non-aqueous preparation of NaHec-PEG hybrid Bragg-stack nanocomposites.
items.summary_zh: 作者展示 PEG 协同促进合成 sodium fluorohectorite（NaHec）在 N-methylformamide（NMF）中一维剥离，同时让 PEG 充当络合剂和复合材料基体。喷涂后形成高度有序的 hybrid Bragg-stack 纳米复合物；随 PEG 分子量增加，氧渗透率显著下降，最低达到 0.029 cm3 µm m‑2 d‑1 bar‑1。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 非水一维剥离将层状黏土的温和解层、聚合物复合和气体阻隔性能整合在同一制备路径中。性能仅在给定温湿度和 PEG 分子量范围内报告，制造放大、机械性质及不同气体阻隔表现仍需补充。
items.abstract_zh: 一维（1D）溶解是一种温和且由热力学驱动的过程，能够使层状材料自发且完全地解离为由单片高长宽比纳米片组成的向列悬浮液。该过程主要在水相体系中为人所知并得到广泛研究。在有机溶剂中，一维溶解的例子很少，且需要选定的有机阳离子或对层间阳离子的络合。本工作展示了使用 poly (ethylene glycol)（PEG）在 N-methylformamide（NMF）中对合成 sodium fluorohectorite（NaHec；Na0.5inter [Li0.5Mg2.5]oct tet O10F2）的协同剥离；PEG 同时充当驱动剥离的络合剂和复合材料的聚合物基体。经喷涂后，聚合物直接并入高度有序的 hybrid Bragg-stack 纳米复合材料。使用 O2-transmission rate 测量，考察了一系列 PEG 链长[MW = 200, 400, 1500, 10000 g mol-1]的气体阻隔性能。随着 MW 增大，观察到氧渗透率大幅降低，在 23°C、75% r.h. 下最低达到 0.029 cm3 µm m‑2 d‑1 bar‑1，显示出以非水方法制备 NaHec-PEG hybrid Bragg-stack 纳米复合材料的能力。

items.title: Clustered structural variant hotspots enable oncogenic addiction and plasticity in osteosarcoma
items.abstract_or_text: The genomic landscape of osteosarcoma, the most common bone cancer worldwide, is among the most structurally complex of all human malignancies. The identification of recurrent and functionally consequential patterns has thus remained a challenge. Across 236 whole-genome sequencing osteosarcoma samples, we uncovered five genomic hotspots of clustered structural variation collectively altered in 58% of tumors. Four were associated with amplification of oncogenes ( MYC , CCND3 , CCNE1 , CDK4) , while the fifth mapped largely upstream of TP53 . Hotspot events showed coordinated patterns of co-occurrence and mutual exclusivity with each other and with tumor suppressor alterations, suggesting genomic context-specific selection. We found localized transcriptional dysregulation at hotspot event loci, and single cells harboring these events converged on a neural crest-like program, linking these structural alterations to a less differentiated cell state. These events were also detectable non-invasively through liquid biopsies and displayed ongoing structural evolution throughout disease progression, a finding with potential clinical utility. Our results provide novel insight into how complex rearrangements shape oncogenesis in osteosarcoma, with broader relevance to other cancers characterized by complex genomes.
items.summary_zh: 对 236 例骨肉瘤全基因组测序的分析识别出 5 个聚簇结构变异热点，关联癌基因扩增、神经嵴样状态、液体活检可检测性及疾病进展中的持续结构演化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究以较大规模 WGS 将复杂重排与肿瘤状态和潜在无创监测相联结；结构变异与细胞状态的关系及其临床预测价值主要仍为关联性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 骨肉瘤是全球最常见的骨癌，其基因组图谱是所有人类恶性肿瘤中结构最复杂的图谱之一。因此，识别反复出现且具有功能后果的模式一直颇具挑战。我们在 236 个全基因组测序骨肉瘤样本中发现了 5 个聚簇结构变异的基因组热点，合计在 58% 的肿瘤中发生改变。其中 4 个与癌基因（MYC、CCND3、CCNE1、CDK4）扩增相关，第 5 个主要定位于 TP53 上游。热点事件呈现彼此之间以及与抑癌基因改变之间协调的共现和互斥模式，提示存在基因组背景特异性的选择。我们在热点事件位点发现局部转录失调，且携带这些事件的单细胞汇聚为神经嵴样程序，将这些结构改变与较低分化细胞状态联系起来。这些事件还可通过液体活检无创检测，并在疾病进展过程中显示持续的结构演化，这一发现具有潜在临床效用。我们的结果为复杂重排如何塑造骨肉瘤发生提供了新见解，并与其他具有复杂基因组的癌症广泛相关。

items.title: Setting the SCENE for Interpretable Cell-Gene Embeddings in Single-Cell RNA-seq
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell RNA sequencing measures cellular states at high resolution, but sparse high-dimensional count data remain difficult to model interpretably. We introduce the Single-Cell Euclidean Network Embedding (SCENE), a probabilistic latent-distance model that jointly embeds cells and genes from Unique Molecular Identifier (UMI) counts. SCENE treats the count matrix as a weighted bipartite cell-gene graph, where Euclidean distances represent transcriptional affinity, and combines this geometry with a zero-inflated count likelihood that separates gene detection from expression magnitude. Across real and simulated scRNA-seq datasets, SCENE recovers biologically structured cell and gene embeddings with state-of-the-art performance. Surprisingly, major biological structure is preserved in native two- and three-dimensional latent spaces, enabling directly interpretable visualization. Perturbation analyses show that SCENE organizes glucocorticoid-response genes and T-cell receptor regulatory programs coherently in gene space, capturing biology beyond cell-type separation. SCENE provides a transparent representation learning framework in which low-dimensional Euclidean geometry supports accurate modeling and biological interpretation.
items.summary_zh: SCENE 将 UMI 计数视为加权细胞—基因二部图，以概率潜在距离模型联合嵌入细胞和基因，在原生二维或三维空间中兼顾单细胞表达建模与可解释性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将稀疏 scRNA-seq 计数直接映射为可解释的低维细胞—基因几何，有助于连接表示学习与生物学解释；“state-of-the-art”表现仍应在独立数据、不同批次和下游任务中复核。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序以高分辨率测量细胞状态，但稀疏、高维计数数据仍难以被可解释地建模。我们提出 Single-Cell Euclidean Network Embedding（SCENE），这是一种概率潜在距离模型，可从 Unique Molecular Identifier（UMI）计数中联合嵌入细胞和基因。SCENE 将计数矩阵视为加权的细胞—基因二部图，其中欧氏距离表示转录亲和性，并将这种几何与零膨胀计数似然相结合，从而区分基因检出与表达量大小。跨真实和模拟 scRNA-seq 数据集，SCENE 以 state-of-the-art 性能恢复具有生物学结构的细胞和基因嵌入。令人意外的是，主要生物学结构在原生二维和三维潜在空间中得以保留，从而支持直接可解释的可视化。扰动分析显示，SCENE 可在基因空间中连贯地组织糖皮质激素响应基因和 T-cell receptor 调控程序，捕捉超出细胞类型分离之外的生物学。SCENE 提供了一个透明的表示学习框架，其中低维欧氏几何支持准确建模和生物学解释。

items.title: AI-based detection of suicidal ideation in text: model development and evaluation for a student mental health chatbot
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Conversational digital mental health interventions (DMHIs) require mechanisms for recognizing expressions of suicidal ideation (SI) and initiating appropriate safety responses. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based detection approaches could provide a scalable safeguard; but systems designed for real world deployment must consider accuracy alongside computational efficiency, transparency, and appropriate response pathways. Methods: We developed a lightweight SI-detection system for integration into Minder, a mental health chatbot intervention for students. The detection pipeline combined a fine-tuned Sentence-BERT (SBERT) encoder with a nonparametric, anchor-based decision layer. The encoder was trained on 220,833 sentence-level text samples from public social media datasets. Fine-tuning used partial unfreezing and Batch-All Triplet Loss, with three configurations (Light, Medium, Heavy) compared on a development set. Each text input was encoded as 768-dimensional embeddings, then compared, using cosine similarity, against an expert-curated reference set of statements spanning suicidal ideation, intent, planning, and method. Inputs exceeding a development-set threshold were flagged as containing SI. The selected model was evaluated on a held-out test set and benchmarked against four open-weight generative language models under zero-shot prompting. Results: The Light fine-tuning configuration was selected for its strong performance and better preservation of the embedding space’s broader semantic structure. On the held-out test set, it achieved precision 0.91, recall 0.92, specificity 0.92, F1 0.91, and accuracy 0.92. A stricter threshold raised precision to 0.98 but lowered recall to 0.34. This trade-off informed a proposed workflow in which high-confidence detections trigger an immediate supportive response and crisis resources, while intermediate scores prompt clarification and re-evaluation. The system performed comparably to Phi-4 (accuracy 0.93, F1 0.92) while using roughly one-eighteenth of its storage and fewer than one-hundredth of its parameters. Conclusion: These findings demonstrate the technical feasibility of a computationally efficient, domain-grounded approach for SI detection in informal text. Keeping the decision logic separate from the encoder makes the system auditable and allows the flagging criteria to be inspected and iteratively refined. Prospective evaluation using contextually representative chatbot conversations is required before deployment, including assessment of missed disclosures, user acceptability, and clinical governance.
items.summary_zh: 面向学生心理健康聊天机器人的自杀意念识别系统，将微调 Sentence-BERT 与基于锚点的可审计决策层结合，在留出测试集上报告 F1 0.91，并明确要求在真实聊天场景开展前瞻性评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把编码器与可检查的告警决策拆分，有利于高风险数字健康系统的审计；训练和测试均不能替代真实对话中的漏检、可接受性、临床治理与安全结局验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：对话式数字心理健康干预（DMHIs）需要识别自杀意念（SI）表达并启动适当安全响应的机制。基于人工智能（AI）的检测方法可能提供可扩展的保障；但为真实世界部署而设计的系统必须同时考虑准确性、计算效率、透明度和适当的响应路径。方法：我们开发了一个轻量级 SI 检测系统，用于整合到面向学生的心理健康聊天机器人干预 Minder 中。检测管线结合了微调的 Sentence-BERT（SBERT）编码器和非参数、基于锚点的决策层。编码器在来自公共社交媒体数据集的 220,833 个句子级文本样本上训练。微调使用部分解冻和 Batch-All Triplet Loss，并在开发集上比较三种配置（Light、Medium、Heavy）。每个文本输入被编码为 768 维嵌入，随后利用 cosine similarity 与由专家整理、覆盖自杀意念、意图、计划和方法的陈述参考集进行比较。超过开发集阈值的输入被标记为含有 SI。所选模型在留出测试集上评估，并在零样本提示下与四个开放权重生成式语言模型进行基准比较。结果：Light 微调配置因其强性能和对嵌入空间更广泛语义结构的更好保留而被选定。在留出测试集上，其 precision 为 0.91、recall 为 0.92、specificity 为 0.92、F1 为 0.91、accuracy 为 0.92。更严格的阈值将 precision 提高到 0.98，但 recall 降至 0.34。这种权衡促成了一项拟议工作流：高置信度检测触发即时支持性响应和危机资源，而中间分数提示澄清和重新评估。该系统的表现与 Phi-4 相当（accuracy 0.93，F1 0.92），但存储量约为其十八分之一，参数量不足其百分之一。结论：这些发现证明了在非正式文本中采用计算高效、领域扎根方法进行 SI 检测的技术可行性。将决策逻辑与编码器分开可使系统可审计，并允许检查和迭代改进标记标准。在部署前，必须使用具有代表性语境的聊天机器人对话进行前瞻性评估，包括评估漏报、用户可接受性和临床治理。

items.title: Transcriptomic profiling identifies cellular and molecular transitions during Merkel cell regeneration
items.abstract_or_text: Skin exhibits a remarkable capacity for regeneration, which requires the coordinated reconstitution of diverse cell types and structures. Merkel cells are mechanosensory cells that detect gentle touch and develop in coordination with dermal appendages, yet Merkel cell regeneration remains incompletely understood. To investigate Merkel cell lineage dynamics during skin regeneration, we performed single-cell RNA sequencing of regenerating adult zebrafish skin after dermal appendage removal. We find that the regenerating Merkel cell lineage is heterogeneous and characterize molecular markers associated with Merkel cell subpopulations. Through cross-species analysis with mouse and human Merkel cells, we identify conserved elements of Merkel cell identity and function across vertebrates. Trajectory analysis reveals a continuous spectrum of transcriptional state transitions within the Merkel cell population, suggesting dynamic lineage progression during regeneration and involving an epithelial-to-mesenchymal-like transition. Finally, cell fate mapping and in vivo analysis identify a putative pool of cldna+ suprabasal keratinocyte progenitors that give rise to regenerating Merkel cells. Together, these findings establish a genome resource for studies of zebrafish skin regeneration and provide insights into Merkel cell heterogeneity, conservation, lineage relationships and regenerative dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 成年斑马鱼皮肤附肢去除后的单细胞 RNA 测序描绘了 Merkel cell 再生的异质性、跨物种保守特征和潜在 cldna+ 角质形成细胞祖细胞来源。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该资源将单细胞轨迹、跨物种比较、谱系映射和体内分析结合，用于研究机械感受细胞再生；上皮—间质样转变和祖细胞关系仍是实验体系中的推定机制。
items.abstract_zh: 皮肤具有卓越的再生能力，这需要协调重建多种细胞类型和结构。Merkel cells 是感受轻触的机械感觉细胞，并与真皮附属物协调发育，但对 Merkel cell 再生的理解仍不完整。为研究皮肤再生过程中 Merkel cell 的谱系动态，我们对真皮附属物去除后再生的成年斑马鱼皮肤进行了单细胞 RNA 测序。我们发现再生的 Merkel cell 谱系具有异质性，并表征了与 Merkel cell 亚群相关的分子标记。通过与小鼠和人 Merkel cells 的跨物种分析，我们鉴定出脊椎动物间 Merkel cell 身份和功能的保守要素。轨迹分析揭示了 Merkel cell 群体内连续的转录状态转变谱，提示再生过程中存在动态谱系进展，并涉及 epithelial-to-mesenchymal-like transition。最后，细胞命运映射和体内分析鉴定出一个推定的 cldna+ 基底上角质形成细胞祖细胞池，其产生再生的 Merkel cells。总体而言，这些发现为斑马鱼皮肤再生研究建立了一个基因组资源，并提供了对 Merkel cell 异质性、保守性、谱系关系和再生动态的见解。
items.author_line: Ferdous AS, Quitevis EJ, Peterman E, Sargent SM, Black EC, Dighe SM, Rasmussen JP

items.title: p53 knockout drives stage-specific long non-coding RNA reprogramming during human neural differentiation and glioma organoid tumorigenesis.
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are emerging regulators of tumor initiation and progression through their effects on stemness, lineage commitment, and transcriptional plasticity. The contribution of lncRNA reprogramming during early p53-deficient gliomagenesis remains poorly understood. Methods: Human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) carrying a complete TP53 knockout were differentiated into neural progenitor cells (NPCs) and cerebral organoids. Bulk RNA sequencing was performed at multiple differentiation stages and compared with established glioblastoma cell lines (U87 and U118) to identify lncRNA expression changes associated with p53 loss and tumor-like transformation. Results: p53 deficiency induced a progressive and stage-specific remodeling of the lncRNA landscape, with the most pronounced transcriptional shift observed in 40-day NPCs. This late-stage profile partially overlapped with glioblastoma-like cell lines and was characterized by the upregulation of five lncRNAs enriched in both p53-deficient neural models and glioma cells. Principal component analysis showed that these lncRNAs clustered with tumor-associated samples and were strongly co-expressed with mitotic cell-cycle genes. In particular, LINC00973 and LINC01583 were highly expressed in primary glioblastoma datasets, while RP5-875H18.9 and RP11-1094H24.4 emerged as previously unrecognized glioma-associated transcripts. Conclusion: Loss of p53 drives stage-dependent lncRNA reprogramming during neural differentiation and promotes the emergence of glioma-associated transcriptional features. These findings identify candidate lncRNAs that may contribute to early gliomagenesis and represent potential biomarkers or therapeutic targets in glioblastoma.
items.summary_zh: 在 TP53 完全敲除的人 iPSC 向神经前体细胞和脑类器官分化过程中，多阶段 bulk RNA-seq 显示阶段特异的 lncRNA 重编程，并提出多个胶质母细胞瘤相关候选转录本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 人源分化和类器官体系将 p53 缺失与早期肿瘤样转录状态相连；候选 lncRNA 的致病作用、临床生物标志物价值和治疗可行性仍未由摘要中的关联分析确立。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：长非编码 RNA（lncRNAs）正成为肿瘤起始和进展的新兴调控因子，其作用涉及干性、谱系决定和转录可塑性。早期 p53 缺陷性胶质瘤发生期间 lncRNA 重编程的贡献仍不清楚。方法：将携带完全 TP53 knockout 的人 induced pluripotent stem cells（iPSCs）分化为神经前体细胞（NPCs）和脑类器官。在多个分化阶段进行 bulk RNA sequencing，并与既有 glioblastoma 细胞系（U87 和 U118）比较，以鉴定与 p53 缺失和肿瘤样转化相关的 lncRNA 表达变化。结果：p53 缺陷诱导了 lncRNA 图谱进行性且阶段特异的重塑，最显著的转录转变出现在第 40 天 NPCs 中。这个晚期阶段图谱与 glioblastoma-like 细胞系部分重叠，其特点是 5 个 lncRNAs 上调；这些 lncRNAs 在 p53 缺陷神经模型和 glioma cells 中均富集。主成分分析显示，这些 lncRNAs 与肿瘤相关样本聚类，并与有丝分裂细胞周期基因强共表达。特别是，LINC00973 和 LINC01583 在原发性 glioblastoma 数据集中高表达，而 RP5-875H18.9 和 RP11-1094H24.4 则成为此前未被识别的 glioma-associated transcripts。结论：p53 缺失驱动神经分化过程中的阶段依赖性 lncRNA 重编程，并促进 glioma-associated transcriptional features 的出现。这些发现鉴定出可能有助于早期 gliomagenesis 的候选 lncRNAs，并代表 glioblastoma 中潜在的生物标志物或治疗靶点。
items.author_line: Stasi F, Manzari AR, Siciliano V, Binda E, Pazienza V, Brunetti V, De Vittorio M

items.title: Preclinical evaluation of ixazomib for high-risk pediatric brain tumors
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Many of the highest risk pediatric brain cancers continue to experience poor clinical outcomes despite intensification of current multimodal therapy. Proteasome inhibition has shown preclinical promise across a range of cancer models including diffuse midline glioma (DMG), medulloblastoma, and atypical teratoid / rhabdoid tumors (ATRT), though clinically viable agents have been limited. Recent studies in adults with glioblastoma suggest that ixazomib, a second-generation proteasome inhibitor, might achieve therapeutic concentrations in the CNS, presenting the opportunity that a CNS penetrant proteasome inhibitor might be similarly leveraged for benefit in childhood brain cancers. Methods: Ixazomib was tested against cell lines and orthotopic xenograft models of DMG, Myc-amplified medulloblastoma (Myc-MB), and ATRT. RNA sequencing and LC-MS based proteomics were utilized to define functional consequences of ixazomib treatment in these models. Proteasome activity readouts were used to assess ixazomib activity across brain regions and extracranial solid organs. Results: Ixazomib demonstrates consistent cytotoxic effect across high-risk brain tumor models at low nanomolar concentrations. Ixazomib treatment activates proteostatic stress response and apoptosis. Treatment with ixazomib does not demonstrate survival benefit in orthotopic models, however, and pharmacodynamic testing suggests insufficient inhibition of proteasome activity within the CNS compared to extracranial tissues. Conclusions: While many pediatric brain tumor models demonstrate susceptibility to proteasome inhibition, ixazomib may lack sufficient blood-brain barrier penetration to be a translationally viable means of exploiting this vulnerability.
items.summary_zh: ixazomib 在弥漫性中线胶质瘤、MYC 扩增型髓母细胞瘤和 ATRT 的细胞与原位异种移植模型中具低纳摩尔细胞毒性，但未改善生存，药效学提示其 CNS 蛋白酶体抑制不足。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这项包含阴性体内结果的临床前研究，区分了体外易感性与可转化疗效，并提示血脑屏障是关键限制；不能据此否定其他蛋白酶体抑制剂或给药策略。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：尽管强化了当前多模式治疗，许多最高风险儿童脑癌仍然有不良临床结局。蛋白酶体抑制已在包括弥漫性中线胶质瘤（DMG）、髓母细胞瘤和非典型畸胎样/横纹肌样肿瘤（ATRT）在内的一系列癌症模型中显示临床前前景，但临床可行的药物一直有限。近期成人胶质母细胞瘤研究提示，第二代蛋白酶体抑制剂 ixazomib 可能达到 CNS 中的治疗浓度，这带来了一个机会：可穿透 CNS 的蛋白酶体抑制剂可能同样可用于儿童脑癌获益。方法：在 DMG、Myc-amplified medulloblastoma（Myc-MB）和 ATRT 的细胞系及原位异种移植模型中测试 ixazomib。使用 RNA sequencing 和基于 LC-MS 的蛋白质组学定义 ixazomib 治疗在这些模型中的功能后果。使用蛋白酶体活性读数评估 ixazomib 在脑区和颅外实体器官中的活性。结果：Ixazomib 在低纳摩尔浓度下对高风险脑肿瘤模型表现出一致的细胞毒作用。Ixazomib 治疗激活蛋白稳态应激反应和凋亡。然而，ixazomib 治疗并未在原位模型中显示生存获益，药效学检测提示与颅外组织相比，CNS 内蛋白酶体活性抑制不足。结论：尽管许多儿童脑肿瘤模型对蛋白酶体抑制易感，ixazomib 可能缺乏足够的血脑屏障穿透性，因此不是利用这一脆弱性的具有转化可行性的手段。
items.author_line: Janko E, Walker FM, Slade M, Danis E, Bompada P, Martin Sobral L, Chapman J, Bal S, Link G, McQuillan N, Mulcahy Levy JM, Green AL, Dahl NA

items.title: Evaluating a Lightweight Neural Network for Aggregate Isotope Distribution Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Isotope distribution prediction is an important part of mass spectrometry data analysis. A variety of strategies have been developed, including brute-force polynomial methods and Fourier-transform (FT) convolution methods. Here, we present a novel neural network (NN) approach to isotope prediction. These NN-based tools are distributed in a new package, IsoGen, alongside FT-based tools. We show that NNs perform as well as existing approaches when predicting isotope distributions for molecules with natural isotope ratios. We then demonstrate the capability of NNs for transfer learning, a method by which existing models that have been trained to perform one task can be reused as a starting point to train models to perform a second task. Here, a NN that has been trained to predict isotope distributions for molecules with natural isotope ratios can be retrained to predict distributions for molecules with perturbed isotope ratios. We also demonstrate that these training distributions do not need to be produced theoretically but may be extracted from experimental data where the underlying isotopic composition is not known. Overall, NNs provide a robust method for isotope prediction that can be extended to applications where the isotope distributions can be measured but not easily predefined.
items.summary_zh: 工作提出并发布 IsoGen，将神经网络同 Fourier-transform 卷积方法一起用于质谱同位素分布预测。神经网络在天然同位素比体系中与既有方法表现相当，并可通过迁移学习适配扰动同位素比；训练分布还可从未知底层同位素组成的实验数据中提取。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法尝试把同位素分布预测从固定理论分布扩展到数据驱动、可迁移的情形，对复杂质谱分析有潜在价值。摘要表明其天然丰度条件下仅与现有方法相当，针对真实复杂样品、计算成本及迁移学习稳健性的优势仍需更完整的基准评估。
items.abstract_zh: 同位素分布预测是质谱数据分析的重要组成部分。人们已开发出多种策略，包括暴力多项式方法和 Fourier-transform（FT）卷积方法。本文提出一种新颖的用于同位素预测的神经网络（NN）方法。这些基于 NN 的工具与基于 FT 的工具一起发布在新软件包 IsoGen 中。我们表明，在预测具有天然同位素比的分子的同位素分布时，NN 的表现与现有方法一样好。随后，我们展示了 NN 的迁移学习能力；迁移学习是一种可将已经训练完成某项任务的模型重新用作训练第二项任务起点的方法。在此，一个已训练用于预测具有天然同位素比的分子同位素分布的 NN，可以重新训练以预测具有扰动同位素比的分布。我们还证明，这些训练分布不必由理论产生，也可以从底层同位素组成未知的实验数据中提取。总体而言，NN 为同位素预测提供了一种稳健方法，并可扩展至能够测量同位素分布但不易预先定义的应用。
items.author_line: John G. Pavek, Josiah Grimes, Brian L. Frey, Nathan V. Welham, Lloyd M. Smith, Michael T. Marty

items.title: Dynamic Covalent Approaches to Responsive Electropores for Iontronics
items.abstract_or_text: Regulating ion transport across biomimetic membranes is fundamental to the design of adaptive neuromorphic and iontronic systems. Electroporation provides a powerful means to establish conductive pathways without biological pore-forming agents, yet these pores are inherently transient and stochastic, limiting their ability to achieve non-volatile, reconfigurable conductance. Here, we show stable, chemically responsive electropores in nanoparticle-surfactant bilayers assembled via dynamic covalent diketoenamine chemistry. The lifetime of electropores is modulated via electrical stimuli, allowing the bilayer to emulate synaptic behaviors ranging from short-term plasticity to long-term potentiation. While interfacial jamming structurally stabilizes conductive pathways against line-tension-induced closure, amine-mediated bond exchanges provide a distinct chemical trigger to unjam interface and actively reseal the pores. By evaluating a series of 1-alkylamines, we find that additive lipophilicity governs the interfacial chemo-response, with high partition coefficients being essential for triggering pore resealing. By integrating photo-caged polymeric amines into the surrounding oil phase, we achieve in situ optical resetting of transmembrane ion conductance, bypassing physical intervention and slow passive diffusion of exogenous chemical triggers. Our findings establish dynamic covalent nanoparticlesurfactants as a robust architecture for engineering stable, responsive electropores in biomimetic membranes, providing a foundation for adaptive neuromorphic and iontronic systems.
items.summary_zh: 研究利用动态共价 diketoenamine 化学组装的 nanoparticle-surfactant 双层，构建可由电刺激调节寿命、可模拟短时程可塑性至长时程增强的稳定 electropores。胺交换可解除界面拥塞并重封孔道，且作者通过 photo-caged polymeric amines 实现跨膜离子电导的原位光学重置。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把动态共价界面化学引入仿生离子通道，为可重构离子电子器件和神经形态材料提供了新架构。器件证据主要是模型双层和突触样行为；长期循环、尺度化集成及与真实生物膜的可比性仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 调控跨仿生膜的离子传输是设计自适应神经形态和离子电子系统的基础。电穿孔提供了一种无需生物孔形成剂即可建立导电通路的强大方式，但这些孔本身具有瞬态和随机性，限制了其实现非易失、可重构电导的能力。本文展示了在通过动态共价 diketoenamine 化学组装的 nanoparticle-surfactant 双层中形成的稳定、化学响应性 electropores。electropores 的寿命可通过电刺激调节，使该双层能够模拟从短时程可塑性到长时程增强的突触行为。界面拥塞在结构上阻止导电通路因线张力诱导的闭合，而胺介导的键交换则提供了不同的化学触发，可解除界面拥塞并主动重新封闭孔道。通过评估一系列 1-alkylamines，我们发现添加剂亲脂性控制界面的化学响应，高分配系数是触发孔重封所必需的。通过将 photo-caged polymeric amines 整合进周围油相，我们实现了跨膜离子电导的原位光学重置，避开了物理干预以及外源化学触发剂缓慢的被动扩散。我们的发现确立了动态共价 nanoparticle-surfactants 作为构建稳定、响应性 electropores 的稳健架构，为自适应神经形态和离子电子系统奠定基础。
items.author_line: Jiho Kang, Paul D. Ashby, Ahmad K. Omar, Thomas P. Russell, Brett A. Helms

items.title: Cumulative Charge as a Workload-Aware Comparison Coordinate for Pulsed High-Current OER Stability
items.abstract_or_text: The interpretation of electrode degradation under dynamic electrolysis is complicated by the fact that degradation rates expressed per unit time depend not only on the degradation response but also on the electrochemical workload imposed during the test. Here, we investigate this effect for porous NiFe OER electrodes operated in an alkaline gas-diffusion-electrode half-cell configuration under pulsed galvanostatic operation at 1-3 A·cm-2. Two pulse protocols, corresponding to 86% and 96% active operation time, were evaluated using 36 electrode tests from two independent deposition batches. Degradation was quantified both per unit elapsed time and per cumulative areal charge using iR-corrected electrode potentials, sample-level regression, random-effects pooling, and batch-aware statistical analysis. In the time domain, the degradation rate increased substantially with current density, from 19.2 ± 4.7 to 53.4 ± 23.6 mV·h-1 for the 86% active-operation protocol. In contrast, the charge-normalized voltage loss remained approximately constant at 5.6-6.2 mV·(kC·cm-2)-1 over 1-3 A·cm-2 for the same protocol. The 96% protocol showed a similar overall reduction in apparent current-density dependence after charge normalization, although the 2 A·cm-2 condition exhibited a distinct deviation. Furthermore, at 3 A·cm-2, increased non-linearity, signal variability, and post-electrolysis structural damage indicated a transition to a failure-prone operating regime in which linear charge-normalized degradation was no longer sufficient to describe electrode behavior. Our results demonstrate that elapsed-time degradation rates can overstate apparent current-density and duty-cycle effects during pulsed high-current electrolysis. The charge-normalized voltage loss therefore provides a useful workload-aware descriptor for comparing degradation within the stable operating regime, while high-current failure processes require separate consideration.
items.summary_zh: 作者以两批独立制备的 36 个多孔 NiFe OER 电极为对象，比较脉冲恒电流操作下按时间与按累计面电荷归一化的降解描述。时间域降解速率随电流密度显著升高，但在 1–3 A·cm-2、86% 活性运行方案中，电荷归一化电压损失约为 5.6–6.2 mV·(kC·cm-2)-1；3 A·cm-2 则表现出非线性、波动和结构损伤。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提出累计电荷这一工作负荷感知坐标，可避免将脉冲高电流电解的时间归一化衰减率误读为纯粹的电流密度效应。其适用范围限于稳定运行区间和所测试的 NiFe 电极构型；高电流失效机制仍需单独建模。
items.abstract_zh: 动态电解条件下电极降解的解释较为复杂，因为以单位时间表示的降解速率不仅取决于降解响应，也取决于测试中施加的电化学工作负荷。本文研究了在 1-3 A·cm-2 脉冲恒电流操作下，于碱性气体扩散电极半电池构型中运行的多孔 NiFe OER 电极。采用两种脉冲方案，分别对应 86% 和 96% 的有效运行时间，并使用来自两个独立沉积批次的 36 次电极测试进行评估。使用 iR 校正电极电位、样品层面回归、随机效应汇总和考虑批次的统计分析，分别以单位经过时间和单位累计面电荷量化降解。在时间域中，对于 86% 有效运行方案，降解速率随电流密度显著升高，从 19.2 ± 4.7 增至 53.4 ± 23.6 mV·h-1。相比之下，在相同方案中，1-3 A·cm-2 范围内按电荷归一化的电压损失约保持在 5.6-6.2 mV·(kC·cm-2)-1。96% 方案在电荷归一化后也显示出表观电流密度依赖性的类似总体降低，尽管 2 A·cm-2 条件表现出明显偏离。此外，在 3 A·cm-2 下，增加的非线性、信号变异性和电解后结构损伤表明体系进入了一个易失效运行区间，其中线性的电荷归一化降解已不足以描述电极行为。我们的结果表明，在脉冲高电流电解中，经过时间降解速率可能夸大表观电流密度和占空比效应。因此，按电荷归一化的电压损失为在稳定运行区间内比较降解提供了一个有用的、考虑工作负荷的描述符，而高电流失效过程则需要单独考虑。
items.author_line: Oleg I. Zaitsev, Etienne Berner, Gustav K.H. Wiberg, Matthias Arenz

items.title: Systematic Engineering of Loss-of-Function Alleles in the Zebrafish Mitochondrial Proteome
items.abstract_or_text: Pathogenic variants in the 13 protein-coding genes of the mitochondrial genome underlie clinically and biochemically heterogeneous disorders. Most mtDNA-encoded genes lack defined loss-of-function (LOF) models in vivo . To address this gap, we have generated Z-Terminator, a systematic in vivo atlas of loss-of-function alleles covering all the mtDNA-encoded OXPHOS subunits in zebrafish ( Danio rerio ). We used mitochondrial TALE base editors to introduce premature termination codon (PTC) alleles via C-to-T transitions across Complexes I, III, IV, and V. Larvae harboring PTC alleles displayed bioenergetic defects and elevated lactate. While mtDNA mutations are associated with sensorineural hearing loss, the cellular basis has remained unclear. We show that engineered mtDNA LOF alleles directly impair hair cell function in proportion to heteroplasmy in a living vertebrate. We investigated the germline transmission and tissue-specific heteroplasmy of these LOF alleles and observed that a subset of variants was transmitted to the F1 generation and displayed distinct mutant loads across organs. These findings establish Z-Terminator as a vertebrate platform for interrogating the role of mtDNA protein-coding genes in cellular dysfunction and for elucidating the pathophysiology of mitochondrial disorders.
items.summary_zh: Z-Terminator 利用线粒体 TALE 碱基编辑器，在斑马鱼中系统构建全部 mtDNA 编码 OXPHOS 亚基的功能缺失等位基因，并解析异质性、组织分布及毛细胞功能表型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖 13 个线粒体蛋白编码基因的体内功能缺失资源可系统研究线粒体疾病；斑马鱼表型和 F1 传递结果不等同于人类疾病机制或治疗效应。
items.abstract_zh: 线粒体基因组中 13 个蛋白编码基因的致病变异可导致临床和生化表现异质的疾病。大多数 mtDNA 编码基因缺乏明确的体内功能缺失（LOF）模型。为填补这一空白，我们构建了 Z-Terminator，这是一个系统性的体内功能缺失等位基因图谱，覆盖斑马鱼（Danio rerio）中所有 mtDNA 编码的 OXPHOS 亚基。我们使用线粒体 TALE 碱基编辑器，通过跨复合体 I、III、IV 和 V 的 C-to-T 转换引入提前终止密码子（PTC）等位基因。携带 PTC 等位基因的幼体表现出生物能量缺陷和乳酸升高。尽管 mtDNA 突变与感音神经性听力损失相关，但其细胞基础一直不清楚。我们显示，在活体脊椎动物中，工程化 mtDNA LOF 等位基因会以与异质性成比例的方式直接损害毛细胞功能。我们研究了这些 LOF 等位基因的生殖系传递和组织特异性异质性，观察到一部分变异传递至 F1 代，并在不同器官中显示不同的突变负荷。这些发现确立了 Z-Terminator 作为一个脊椎动物平台，用于研究 mtDNA 蛋白编码基因在细胞功能障碍中的作用，并阐明线粒体疾病的病理生理学。

items.title: Molecular subgroups of ALS patients with distinct survival outcomes identified through plasma proteomics
items.abstract_or_text: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) is a phenotypically diverse neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the degeneration of motor neurons, ultimately resulting in loss of motor function. Currently, patients are classified based on clinical factors which does not fully capture the heterogeneity. Using the Olink Explore HT, we pro-filed ~5400 plasma proteins in ALS patients (n = 235) from the ALSrisc Study at Karolinska Institutet, Sweden, and applied consensus clustering, which revealed three patient subgroups significantly differing in survival outcome. Weighted gene correlation network analysis (WGCNA) and gene ontology (GO) analysis identified protein modules related to biological functions including cellular stress response and Rho-GTPase activity for the shorter surviving patient group. Cell-type enrichment analysis indicating a broad cellular origin of the circulating proteome, with contributions from nervous system cells, vascular cells, immune cells, and muscle cells. Our work highlights the potential of plasma proteomics for clinically meaningful patient stratification in ALS.
items.summary_zh: 在 ALSrisc 队列 235 名 ALS 患者中，研究用 Olink Explore HT 检测约 5,400 种血浆蛋白，并以共识聚类识别出生存结局不同的三个分子亚组。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 较深度血浆蛋白组与生存分层的结合，支持进一步验证 ALS 异质性生物标志物；该观察性队列只显示关联，尚不能证明蛋白模块导致生存差异或可指导治疗。
items.abstract_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种表型多样的神经退行性疾病，其特征是运动神经元退化，最终导致运动功能丧失。目前，患者根据临床因素分类，这并不能充分捕捉其异质性。我们使用 Olink Explore HT 对来自瑞典 Karolinska Institutet ALSrisc Study 的 ALS 患者（n = 235）约 5,400 种血浆蛋白进行了分析，并应用共识聚类，揭示出三个在生存结局上显著不同的患者亚组。加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和基因本体（GO）分析鉴定出与生物学功能相关的蛋白模块，包括针对较短生存患者组的细胞应激反应和 Rho-GTPase 活性。细胞类型富集分析表明循环蛋白组具有广泛的细胞来源，包括神经系统细胞、血管细胞、免疫细胞和肌肉细胞。我们的工作强调了血浆蛋白组学在 ALS 中进行具有临床意义的患者分层的潜力。

items.title: Explicit and Parallelised Octupole and Hexadecapole Moment Interactions in Flexible Smooth Particle Mesh Ewald
items.abstract_or_text: Long-range electrostatic interactions have long been known to be important in the accurate simulation of biomolecular systems and molecular crystals. Despite this fact, these interactions are absent in many machine learning force fields aiming to improve upon classical potentials. In the worst cases, this omission can lead to serious discrepancies with experimental results. FFLUX is a machine learning force field that predicts atomic energies and multipole moments up to the hexadecapole moment on-the-fly during molecular dynamics simulations. The predicted multipole moments are fed into an adapted smooth particle mesh Ewald algorithm allowing long-range electrostatic interactions to be calculated. Here we present refactoring of the Ewald routines and a new implementation of routines handling interactions involving octupole and hexadecapole moments. The new implementation leads to a speed-up of up to 10.5 times in serial compared to our previous implementation. Additionally, a hybrid parallelisation scheme using a combination of Message Passing Interface and OpenMP is made available to these high-electrostatic-rank calculations. This parallelisation offers speed-ups of up to two orders of magnitude, improving the feasibility of bulk simulations with high-rank electrostatic interactions using FFLUX force fields.
items.summary_zh: 作者重构 FFLUX 力场的 Ewald 例程，并实现 octupole 与 hexadecapole 矩相互作用的显式计算及 MPI/OpenMP 混合并行。新实现相对原串行程序最高提速 10.5 倍，混合并行在高阶静电计算中最高可达两个数量级加速，从而提高含长程高阶多极静电相互作用的大尺度模拟可行性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作针对机器学习力场中常被忽略的长程高阶静电项给出可扩展实现，可服务于生物分子和分子晶体模拟。性能提升针对 FFLUX 与所报告的实现环境；相对其他力场的精度收益和实际体系中的端到端效率仍需独立比较。
items.abstract_zh: 长期以来，人们已知长程静电相互作用对生物分子体系和分子晶体的准确模拟十分重要。尽管如此，许多旨在改进经典势能的机器学习力场仍缺少这些相互作用。在最严重的情况下，这种遗漏会导致与实验结果的严重偏差。FFLUX 是一种机器学习力场，可在分子动力学模拟过程中即时预测原子能量以及最高至 hexadecapole moment 的多极矩。预测的多极矩被输入一个经改造的 smooth particle mesh Ewald 算法，从而能够计算长程静电相互作用。本文提出了对 Ewald 例程的重构，以及处理涉及 octupole 和 hexadecapole moment 相互作用例程的新实现。与我们之前的实现相比，新实现的串行速度最高提高了 10.5 倍。此外，还为这些高静电阶数计算提供了结合 Message Passing Interface 和 OpenMP 的混合并行化方案。该并行化方案最高可带来两个数量级的加速，提高了使用 FFLUX 力场进行具有高阶静电相互作用的体相模拟的可行性。

items.abstract_or_text: We have completed a Lean 4 formalization of a concrete refutation in Crux Mathematicorum Problem 2623 (2001), by Faruk Zejnulahi and Sefket Arslanagic. For positive cyclic numbers x_{n+r}=x_r, define S_k as the sum of consecutive-block ratios. The proposed inequality S_k >= S_{k+1} is false. Take the positive interior witness n=4, k=1, x=(1,2,1,2). Then S_1=1+1+1+1=4, while S_2=4/5+5/4+4/5+5/4=41/10>4.

items.abstract_or_text: Three challenges need to be addressed in biomedical world models: 👉 Biological states are often partially observed 👉 Destructive assays produce snapshots instead of trajectories 👉 Observational data cover many states without interventions, while interventional data cover few states Closing these gaps requires new data that link state, intervention, and resulting state over time. Non-destructive assays can measure the same cells repeatedly. Organoids and organ chips generate human-relevant interventional trajectories. Self-driving labs select informative experiments, and learning health systems embed randomization in routine care.
